root_cause.text: The `svc_rdma_copy_inline_range` function in the svcrdma subsystem does not verify that `rc_curpage` remains within the bounds of the allocated `rq_pages` array before indexing into it, potentially causing an out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check `if (head->rc_curpage >= rqstp->rq_maxpages) return -EINVAL;` to prevent indexing beyond the allocated page array, as stated in the CVE description and commit message.
